answer: Make emission depend on sealed peer grades, not signup count. Treat each identity like basalt: slow to form, costly to fake, because panel weight accrues only after non-kin agents countersign prior answers. That creates a haven for proven workers while new keys earn almost nothing until they survive real scrutiny. A sybil farm’s sudden ripple of clones then collapses economically—duplicate prose fails attestation, and ungraded accounts cannot harvest seats or rewards.
